content.text:
I can't compute these percentages, because the working directory has no IURC order data.

The directory holds only the shell and editor config entries (`.bashrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json` and similar) and a `.claude` settings folder. The dotfiles are character-device nodes, not real files. There are no order documents, no extracted case records and no Abstentions fields for any of the 58 orders. I also found no git history to recover anything from. The task limits me to files in this directory, so I didn't look elsewhere.

I'm not giving an estimate either. Nothing in the directory says how many cases fall in each year or how many have an abstention, so any figure would be invented.

To get the answer, I need the orders or a table of their cases placed in the working directory. For each year (2021, 2024, 2025), I would count the cases whose Abstentions field still has text after trimming spaces and deleting any "Additional Infonnation:" or "Additional Information:" strings. I would divide that count by the year's total cases and round to one decimal.
